original_requirement: Supply linked guidance outside normal discovery or name incomplete coverage, retaining source identity, scope and authority.
before: Normal policy contexts observe links outside conventional discovery but do not supply their target contents. Callers must make an additional source read even for small applicable shared guidance.
source_after: Normal scoped contexts supply complete bounded first-hop linked Markdown evidence alongside direct policy, with source hashes and explicit applicability/authority separation. Missing, excluded and budget-limited targets remain named.
finite_acceptance: A selected guide links an applicable small Markdown document outside discovery; complete body/hash arrives as linked evidence while direct policy sources, qualifications and authority remain unchanged.

Declared nonmatching scope is not supplied. Linked documents share remaining direct-policy output budgets and a finite read budget; no recursive crawling or partial policy. Named omissions retain exact hash-bound recovery when a complete fingerprint was obtained.

Both JSON and Markdown expose the same supplied linked evidence; historical contexts never fetch current disk targets. File edits change linked fingerprints and exact-recovery actions. No index/authored writes or actual LegacyValidation whole-project operation.
checks_completed: Installed owned baseline confirms ordinary context observes but does not supply a linked shared document.

checks_deferred: Run focused linked-policy tests in the combined batch.
